source: Original ordered native server timing lines; actual prompt-eval and generation-eval token counts. Generic OAI app did not persist API prompt-total/cache-hit/output counters, which remain unavailable.
error_or_unavailable_reason: CLI stop observed original process exit/endpoint disappearance; no separate host-release snapshot was recorded on this failed attempt. Raw full probe evidence is preserved only in the external owned artifact directory. Unrelated process/device catalogs and personal paths are intentionally omitted.
association_limit: Ordered association for sequential synthetic text submissions only; no native task-ID to app UUID proof. App completion UUID matching is independently retained in original records. First text of a new app is NOT necessarily cold prefix: generic server survives app restart; managed prefix preparation/restore precedes text.
wall_metric_boundary: CLI text-submit launch to matched completed translation event; not native inference alone or audio/STT/GUI latency.

unavailable_phase_reasons.three_slots: Actual app probe submitted sequentially; simultaneous occupancy is measured in standalone matrix, not fabricated for app.
unavailable_phase_reasons.first_prefix: First text per fresh app is not guaranteed cold: explicit preparation/restore or surviving external server precedes it.
